Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: http://careers.bhel.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 28-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the BHEL Part Time Medical Consultant recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the BHEL Part Time Medical Consultant position is 28th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree along with at least one year of working experience in any registered hospital to be eligible for this role.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Part Time Medical Consultant position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 65 years. However, this can be relaxed up to 70 years with the approval of the Competent Authority.

faq.question: Q4. How will candidates be selected for the Part Time Medical Consultant role?
faq.answer: The selection process for this recruitment will be based on an interview conducted by Bharat Heavy Electricals.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Part Time Medical Consultant post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will be compensated at a rate of Rs. 500/- per hour for their services.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Part Time Medical Consultant position announced in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. In which mode should the application be submitted?
faq.answer: Interested candidates are required to apply through the offline mode by sending their application form to the official address.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the BHEL located for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for BHEL in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, with the pincode 600100.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this Part Time Medical Consultant recruitment is PSSR:HR:301.04.
